summary: Unchanged last draft; the run is within about two minutes of expiry, all questions are answered or explicitly bounded, and I am not filling the interval with marginal work. The record stands: three receipt-backed defects (unbound leadership-transfer acceptance; the constant-zero configuration index defeating the documented `prevIndex` guard; repeated identical automatic snapshots on a snapshot-recovered idle node, with control), one conditional finding (deprecated voter-only peer encoding on a below-protocol-2 leader after a rollback-style restart), and sourced behaviours with explicit limits, with the two unresolved boundaries left flagged rather than smoothed over.
